//en: Optional config for realtime_translate.py. Copy this file to realtime_translate.json next to the script, or under ~/.dfi18n/. All fields optional.

//data_dir-en: Dictionary dir = <mods>/<a data mod>/dfi18n-data/simple/zh-Hans. Auto-detect prefers a mod that already has ai_fill.csv; otherwise it picks a subscribed data mod such as 3635900931. Translations are written to ai_fill.csv there (created if missing).
